description: Searches the Gear & Glam curated catalog by keyword, product category (Gear, Glam, Home, Premium Jewellery, Beauty & Vanity, Tech Gear, Luxury Timeless Décor), or stock availability. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'search_products' on Gear & Glam Store (gearandglam.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'get_product_details' or 'check_inventory' or 'calculate_order_total' for their respective operations). Parameters: query (optional), category (optional), limit (optional), in_stock_only (optional). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

category.description: Filter by product pillar or curated collection category [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

in_stock_only.description: Filter only items currently in stock [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

query.description: Search term (e.g. jewellery, beauty, tech gear, decor, gift) [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

name: search_products
title: Search Products
